brief: The same school class bell, repaired: a small brass hand bell of a 1960s village school class, about 12 cm tall, polished warm brass with a few dull spots, a turned dark-brown wooden handle on its crown, standing and tilted towards the viewer so that its open mouth is visible: inside, the small metal clapper hangs free on a new short loop of tan leather whose knot is tucked away inside; no handkerchief; the brass gleams.
